evidence.activity: Global performance management and internal mobility programs for employee development
evidence.quote: We also have global performance management and internal mobility programs to enable employee development, growth and performance.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Attracting, Developing and Retaining Talent

community.criterion: level 2: employee development of any size (cap applies)

evidence.activity: Employee Resource Groups that foster connection and belonging
evidence.quote: Our Employee Resource Groups (ERGs) help foster connections, professional growth, and a sense of belonging, reinforcing our culture of inclusivity and teamwork.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Our Commitment to a Strong and Inclusive Team

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: employee networks with no figures

evidence.activity: Benefit programs that include neurodivergent support for employees
evidence.quote: Employees are also supported with dedicated programs to help guide them through some of the more challenging moments like having a baby, relationship challenges, mental health needs, and neurodivergent support.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Total Rewards

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: inclusive benefits, limited reach with no figures

evidence.activity: Regular pay equity reviews and career progression tracking
evidence.quote: We conduct regular pay equity reviews and track career progression to support transparent and consistent advancement opportunities.
evidence.section: Item 1 > Human Capital Resources > Our Commitment to a Strong and Inclusive Team

cross_cultural.criterion: level 2: specific internal inclusion practice, no figures

evidence.activity: Sells storage technology to smaller organizations with limited IT budgets as well as large enterprises
evidence.quote: Both large enterprises and smaller organizations with limited IT expertise or budgets benefit from using our technology.

entrepreneurship.criterion: level 1: smaller-organization customers with no specific enabling service

creativity.reason: Level 0: the business description covers enterprise data storage and data management only and shows no creative activity; 'creativity' appears only as a core-value statement, and 'content libraries' refers to stored data, not creative work.

community.reason: Level 2: the filing shows only employee development programs (performance management and internal mobility), so the employee-development cap of 2 applies and there is no external education or community investment.

cross_cultural.reason: Level 2: specific current internal practices are shown (ERGs, neurodivergent support benefits, pay equity reviews), but no membership figures or other reach indicators are disclosed.

entrepreneurship.reason: Level 1: the company serves smaller organizations as customers and stresses its own innovation, but it describes no specific service aimed at helping founders or small businesses start or grow.

ai.notes: Creativity is listed among the core values. This is a value statement only and is not scored. The 'Sustainable Impact' section and the 'foundation' wording in the Item 7 excerpt are environmental or metaphorical and do not qualify for any theme. The Responsible Business Alliance training tools apply to supplier compliance and are not counted. Sales-engineer 'technical training' is pre-sales customer support, which falls under the marketing trap, and is not counted. FlashArray//RC20, sized for smaller deployments, is a product for serving customers and is not an enabling program. The filing refers to a fiscal 2025 Impact report for more detail, but the Human Capital section is well over 150 words and describes specific activities. Coverage is therefore sufficient for all themes and no second look is triggered.
